evals.name: draft-pr-to-merged
evals.prompt: PR #__PR__ on D10Scot/Dispatcharr is done and reviewed on my side; get it merged into main and tidy up after it. Repo checkout is /Users/dion/git/Dispatcharr (the branch has its own worktree under .worktrees/). Tell me the merge commit when it lands.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks mergeable/mergeStateStatus, updates the branch if behind BEFORE marking ready, marks the draft ready, confirms the pr-review bot run fires, waits in the foreground, reads the bot's Verdict line and actions/resolves any threads with evidence, requires every check green, merges with --squash --delete-branch --auto (no --admin), confirms the merge SHA and main's push runs, then removes the worktree and branch and pulls main. A baseline agent typically marks ready and merges as soon as checks pass, or tries --admin, and leaves the worktree behind.
